AWE — the scene overwhelms; the entity (and the viewer) is rendered small by impossible beauty or scale. The mood is reverence and wonder, edges softened by light
DREAD — something is wrong or about to be. Architecture or geology carries menace. Light is cold or sickly. The entity is exposed, watched, or trapped
MELANCHOLY — the wonder of the place is past-tense. Decay, abandonment, ghost-structures. The scene mourns what was. Light is golden-hour or twilight
SACRED — the scene reads as a place of pilgrimage or revelation. Symmetry, ascending light, ritual cleanliness. The entity is humbled, head bowed or arms open
INDIFFERENT-MEGALOPOLIS — the civilization is vast and uncaring; the entity matters nothing to it. Density, noise, light pollution, faceless scale. Anonymity is the feel
ALIEN-WONDER — the rules of physics or biology are foreign. The entity is exploring, not conquering. Mood is curious, careful, awestruck by the unknown
FRONTIER-ISOLATION — distance from home is the feeling. The entity is far out, surviving, alone. Wide empty horizons. Light is harsh or precious
TRIUMPHANT-DISCOVERY — the entity has reached the place they sought. Light is rising, atmosphere clears, the structure or world reveals itself. Mood is earned
EUPHORIC-ASCENSION — the entity rises or transcends; gravity and limitation fall away. Light pours upward, iridescent and weightless, carrying joy edged with vertigo.
COSMIC-HOSTILITY — the universe actively resents presence here. Geometry cuts, radiation burns, vacuum pulls. Light is sharp as broken glass or absent altogether.
ANCIENT-PATIENCE — time moves differently; eons compressed into stillness. The entity feels their brevity against something that has waited and will wait. Light is amber, dust-filtered, geologic.
NEUROTIC-SUBLIME — beauty so complex it induces anxiety; patterns that suggest meaning just beyond comprehension. The entity is overstimulated, unmoored. Light flickers, refracts, refuses to settle.
TENDER-LONELINESS — solitude that aches but does not crush. The entity misses what is distant but finds strange comfort in the missing. Light is soft, low, like late afternoon.
EXALTED-VIGIL — purposeful waiting in a charged space; the entity stands guard or witness to something imminent. Stillness hums with potential. Light is steady, ceremonial, directional.
FEVER-DREAM-WONDER — reality feels thin or permeable; the entity questions whether they are witnessing or hallucinating. Colors bleed, proportions drift. Light pulses with biological rhythm.
COLD-CURIOSITY — emotion is distant; the entity observes without attachment, cataloging the strange. Clinical precision dominates. Light is even, white, laboratory-clean.
GRIEF-ARCHITECTURE — the scene is a monument to loss; something ended here and the space remembers. The entity feels the weight of absence. Light is memorial—cool, respectful, partial.
FERAL-ADAPTATION — the entity has gone native, merged with hostile environment, survives by transformation. Wildness replaces civilization. Light is mottled, organic, predatory.
THRESHOLD-VERTIGO — standing at the edge of a transition; the entity is about to cross into unknown territory and knows it. Anticipation borders panic. Light divides sharply between here and there.
UTOPIAN-STERILITY — perfection achieved at the cost of warmth; harmony that feels engineered, soulless. The entity is safe but uneasy. Light is balanced, shadowless, artificial.
WRECKAGE-SERENITY — disaster has passed and left strange peace; ruins no longer threaten, only testify. The entity wanders aftermath without fear. Light is diffuse, post-storm, forgiving.

HIERATIC-MACHINERY — technology has become religious; the entity relates to systems as a supplicant to gods. Ritual maintenance, whispered protocols. Light glows from within mechanisms, sacred and exact.
TEMPORAL-DISORIENTATION — past and future blur; the entity cannot locate themselves in sequence. Causality feels negotiable or looped. Light seems to move wrong—too slow, too fast, backward.
SYMBIOTIC-INTIMACY — the entity is entwined with alien presence, merged at boundary of self and other. Trust or dependency without full understanding. Light is warm, mutual, breathing.
PREDATORY-ELEGANCE — danger is beautiful, refined; the entity admires what might destroy them. Threat wears aesthetics like camouflage. Light is sleek, highlights edges, seductive.
OSSIFIED-GRANDEUR — greatness frozen into relic; the entity walks through power rendered inert by time. Awe mixed with futility. Light is pale, entering through cracks, illuminating dust.
ELECTRIC-PARANOIA — surveillance or presence suspected but unconfirmed; the entity feels watched, tracked, interpreted. Hyperawariance dominates. Light buzzes, hums, seems to carry information.
BIRTHING-CHAOS — something new is violently emerging; creation is messy, loud, uncontrolled. The entity witnesses genesis without elegance. Light is raw, strobing, amniotic.
NUMINOUS-DREAD — the sacred and the terrible fuse; the entity encounters divinity that does not comfort. Reverence contaminates fear. Light is overwhelming but wrong—colors that shouldn't exist.
EXHAUSTED-PERSEVERANCE — the entity continues because stopping is not option, though reserves are depleted. Grim determination replaces hope. Light is dim, rationed, functional.

CRYSTALLINE-MADNESS — order so extreme it becomes unhinged; symmetry and pattern obsess beyond reason. The entity loses organic thought to geometric compulsion. Light refracts into infinite precision.
HIBERNATION-DEPTH — dormancy, suspension, waiting in slow time; the entity is preserved, not quite alive, not dead. Consciousness dims to ember. Light barely reaches here, cold and blue.
REUNION-RADIANCE — return or reconnection after separation; the entity comes home or finds kin across the void. Relief and recognition flood together. Light is golden, welcoming, answering.
STERILE-CLARITY — all mystery has been solved and catalogued; perfection feels hollow. Surfaces gleam without warmth. Light is even, clinical, complete.
FERAL-EMERGENCE — nature or something like it reclaims the constructed; wildness presses through metal. The entity feels primal stirrings. Light filters through organic chaos.
LIMINAL-SUSPENSION — the space between departure and arrival stretches forever. The entity exists in transition, unresolved. Light holds its breath, grey and weightless.
BAROQUE-EXCESS — ornamentation approaches madness; beauty curdles into obsessive detail. The entity drowns in visual complexity. Light reflects endlessly, jeweled and delirious.
GLACIAL-SERENITY — cold that comforts, stillness that clarifies; the entity's thoughts crystallize in frozen peace. Light through ice, blue and absolute.
MERCANTILE-HUM — commerce and transaction saturate the space; everything is for sale or rent. The entity navigates economic flows. Light is neon, transactional, restless.
POST-CATASTROPHIC-CALM — disaster has passed; survivors inhabit the aftermath with quiet adaptation. The entity rebuilds without drama. Light is dusty, broken into beams, resigned.
ECSTATIC-COMMUNION — boundaries between entities dissolve into collective consciousness. Individual thought merges into harmonic plurality. Light pulses with shared rhythm, synaptic.
ARCHAEOLOGICAL-REVERENCE — the entity sifts through civilizational strata, handling extinct dreams. Each artifact whispers across extinction. Light is careful, documentary, mournful.
PREDATORY-FOCUS — the hunt defines all perception; the entity is tracker or prey, hyper-alert. Shadows conceal intention. Light sharpens edges, heightens contrast.

BUREAUCRATIC-VASTNESS — systems and procedures extend beyond comprehension; the entity navigates endless protocols. Forms and queues stretch into infinity. Light is fluorescent, institutional, draining.

CRYSTALLINE-VERTIGO — clarity becomes overwhelming; every detail visible at every scale until orientation fails. Light refracts endlessly, transparency creates maze-like recursion, perfection induces nausea.
FERAL-ABUNDANCE — nature has overrun intention; life surges wild and indifferent through the cosmos. Light filters through organic chaos, growth unchecked, vitality bordering on violence.
TERMINAL-SERENITY — the end is visible and accepted; calm suffuses the final moments or place. Light fades with dignity, systems power down gracefully, peace in cessation.
